close_outcome.reason: REQ-MEM-001 enables the attached close-time flush by default, REQ-MEM-004 says setTarget does not test truth and propagates the same truth-test exception after close cleanup, and REQ-MEM-007 requires the attached flush even below thresholds. Receiver's first check raises ArithmeticError; outcome reports that exact class.

after_close.reason: REQ-MEM-003 retains the two records before close. REQ-MEM-004 tests the receiver once, preserves that check effect, never enters handle, and skips the clear. REQ-MEM-007 then detaches and performs a detached flush that cannot call Receiver. The copied history, record order and both identity tests therefore give exactly the keyed values.

after_recovery.reason: REQ-MEM-004/007 permit post-close reattachment, with no truth check in the setter. The explicit retry performs the second check, which the fixture now makes successful. REQ-MEM-004/005 then visit north,south in order and clear normally. The installed receiver remains the target and outcome is 'ok'.
